recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce the old invalid example references; if DeviceUsage is restored to the active build, review its example in that separate restoration context rather than as remaining FHIR-24933 work.
issue_request: FHIR-24933 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for R5 application. It reported five R4 example-data bugs: Questionnaire/qs1 items missing required linkId values, Observation/clinical-gender using Encounter as Observation.performer, DeviceMetric/example using DeviceDefinition as DeviceMetric.parent, DeviceUseStatement/example using Procedure as reasonReference, and MedicationRequest/medrx0301 using Practitioner as dispenseRequest.performer.
initial_application: Commit 5db566a208601df59e6c725326554e94cdc68112, titled "GF#24933 -  fix wrong resources + R4 technical corrections", changed the Observation, DeviceMetric, DeviceUseStatement, and MedicationRequest examples to valid references for the then-current model. Jira comments and the GF#24933 Zulip thread record Grahame Grieve confirming that the bug and examples needing fixes were fixed.
additional_context: Observation, DeviceMetric, MedicationRequest, and Questionnaire remain active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later decisions changed the surrounding model: FHIR-24701 renamed MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.performer to dispenseRequest.dispenser, and FHIR-31478 renamed DeviceUseStatement to DeviceUsage; both already have audit commits on the combined branch. DeviceUsage is not currently listed as an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and DeviceUseStatement remains only as a compatibility alias.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current source has no Questionnaire/qs1 example; Observation/clinical-gender performer points to Practitioner/example; DeviceMetric/example has a DeviceMetric.device reference and no parent element; the retained DeviceUsage/example source points reason to Condition/example; and MedicationRequest/medrx0301 uses dispenseRequest.dispenser with an Organization reference.

related_jiras.note: Renamed MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.performer to dispenseRequest.dispenser, explaining the current corrected example path; already audited on the combined branch.
Renamed DeviceUseStatement to DeviceUsage, explaining the current source location and compatibility alias; already audited on the combined branch.
